//: Renovate is preferred over Dependabot here because it honours a minimum release age, which can be aligned with minimumReleaseAge: 1440 in pnpm-workspace.yaml. Dependabot would propose same-day releases that the package manager then refuses, which is noisy and confusing. See docs/ci-verification.md.

packageRules.//: Cryptographic dependencies get their own reviewable PR, never grouped and never automerged. A provenance check is required before adopting any of these; record the decision in the PR.
Extension runtime and build toolchain: separate PR, no automerge. A wxt or react change can alter what ships to users.
Routine dev-tooling minor and patch updates can be grouped to keep review volume sane. Still gated by the required verification workflow.
React Doctor is pinned to an exact version on purpose: a score is only stable against a fixed rule set. Renovate may propose bumps, but they are reviewed like any other tool change.
